title: Winner Announced! WHQ - Chaos Adversary Cards give away
body:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jrnfWiLWFJw

Daniel (@dungeondive) draws the Warhammer Quest Chaos Adversary Cards giveaway. Every comment was assigned a number and Google asked for a random one; the winner is Sebastian Lassard, with three weeks to make contact before the prize is redrawn — a policy already being tested by the still-unclaimed Michael Cisco book giveaway.

Then the bad news, which is the reason to watch rather than skip this one. There was supposed to be a second prize: a brand new pack of the Warhammer Quest hero cards, also donated by Sean. It has been lost in the post. Daniel is careful about proportion — this is not medicine, nobody is harmed — but he is plainly gutted, because that pack was very likely one of the last new copies in existence. A ticket is open and the service says it is searching.

The wry caveat he attached to the September announcement, about what the postal service might look like in a few months, turns out to have been prophetic. Deliveries are running long and more parcels are going missing. Two videos and roughly six weeks separate the joke from its consequence, which is the sort of thing only an archive read in order will show you.

----

A pack of out-of-print cards lost in the post, probably one of the last in existence. Is there something in the hobby you know of that vanished the same way?
